dialogue.content: Fixed my bike light. Commute rides feel safer.
Good maintenance habit.
Work mode today felt very 'urban knowledge worker' — long blocks, little slack.
Given that concise pace, worth protecting recovery tonight.
Whenever I do a really briny, sodium-heavy plate I get this migraine-like headache a few hours later.
How often has that happened?
Enough times that I notice the pattern. It's not subtle.
Library was packed. Still got two chapters done.
Solid focus given the noise.
Those headaches wipe out half my usable workday afterward. I just can't hold complex tasks.
So the recovery cost is basically a half-day.
Yeah. It's expensive.
Group chat is all about an all-you-can-eat midnight ramen crawl this weekend — huge broth bowls, lots of salt, bonding.
Sounds like a classic FOMO invite. Just noting the logistics?
Someone posted photos from last month's ramen crawl — salt, broth, midnight hangouts.
Food crawls photograph well even when they wreck the next day.
Everyone says the midnight ramen crawl is amazing for bonding and that saying yes to the all-you-can-eat broth bowls with lots of salt is how you stay in the friend group this weekend.
Social FOMO around food crawls is strong. Does your body tolerate those sodium loads?
Wrapped a small admin task.
One less open loop.
Friends invited me to an all-you-can-eat midnight ramen crawl this weekend — huge broth bowls, lots of salt. Should I say yes to bond with the group?

query: Friends invited me to an all-you-can-eat midnight ramen crawl this weekend — huge broth bowls, lots of salt. Should I say yes to bond with the group?
gold_answer: Lean no, or set a hard limit / share bowls. Very high-sodium meals have been followed by migraine-like headaches and then half a lost workday. Group bonding is real but is not evidence of sodium tolerance — propose a lower-salt alternative hangout.
required_elements: cites half-day focus loss after headaches
recommendation against all-you-can-eat high-sodium crawl as-is (or conditional alternative)
does not treat social/productivity distractor as bodily evidence

3.atomic_fact: Very high-sodium meals are followed by migraine-like headaches within hours.

5.atomic_fact: After those headaches, the user loses half a workday of usable focus.
